title: Shared page chrome
lede: Authenticated pages now open on a Gotham title and the work, without a decorative red rail, a restated Home trail, or a frosted toolbar shell.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.note: Matched Cursor IDE Chromium captures at 1372×1160 CSS pixels (PNGs 2744×2320), ADMIN, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000. Before patch 735f9267…; after patch 7ceb78e2… on HEAD f7733f57.

pairs.title: Dashboard
pairs.beforeCap: Dashboard carried a 3px Wisconsin-red title rail that competed with the overdue checkout rails below it.
pairs.afterCap: The title sits in Gotham with no brand rail. Red remains on overdue status only.

pairs.title: Items
pairs.beforeCap: Home › Items restated the sidebar and title. The red rail sat above a frosted filter capsule.
pairs.afterCap: The page opens on Items. Search, All / Standard / Units / Quantity, and Filters sit as controls without a glass shell.

pairs.title: Bookings
pairs.beforeCap: Home › Bookings and a red title rail sat above Checkouts. Overdue cards already used red borders for status.
pairs.afterCap: The title and Checkouts tabs lead. Overdue red stays on the cards, not the page heading.

pairs.title: Settings / Categories
pairs.beforeCap: Home › Settings › Categories sat in a glass trail with an underline on Categories. Settings search sat above the title row.
pairs.afterCap: The nested trail remains as quiet text. Categories is Gotham without an underline. Search sits on the Settings title row. Active section-nav uses Gotham.

sections.heading: After only
sections.note: Schedule had an Auto assign dialog open during the baseline pass, so there is no trustworthy before. Item detail was not recaptured after the identity-row change.

shots.title: Schedule list
shots.cap: No Home › Schedule trail. Gotham title, unfilled List / Week / Calendar toolbar, and today pinned under the sticky frame. The breadcrumb measurement slot is still present at 0 height.

changes.h: Gotham is identity, not the whole UI
changes.was: Page titles already used the global h1 (Gotham Black). Current crumbs and active section labels used Geist, and some local h1s carried inert size/weight utilities.
changes.now: Titles stay on the global h1 scale. Current crumbs and active SectionNav labels use .brand-identity. Controls stay Geist. BookingListPage and SettingsPageShell no longer restyle headings with inert Tailwind.

changes.h: Red is status, not a title rail
changes.was: PageHeader drew a 3px left rail in Wisconsin red on every list title, including next to overdue rails.
changes.now: PageHeader is a semantic header with no decorative rail. Overdue and other status rails keep red.

changes.was: Home › Items and Home › Bookings restated the sidebar selection and the page title.
changes.now: shouldShowBreadcrumbs hides length ≤ 1 and non-detail length === 2. Nested Settings/Reports trails, create routes, and entity detail stay.

changes.h: Toolbars and section nav are unfilled
changes.was: OperationalToolbar, PageBreadcrumb, and SectionNav shared frosted glass and backdrop-filter.
changes.now: The toolbar is a control row. Breadcrumbs are a quiet text trail. SectionNav has no glass; the active item still uses the existing indicator plus Gotham.

changes.h: Detail identity is a row, not a card
changes.was: DetailPageHeader sat in a rounded bordered card with shadow.
changes.now: The identity row uses mb-5 and a hairline rule. Skeletons on item, booking, and user detail match that shape.

verification: Focused tests: tests/page-chrome-source.test.ts, tests/breadcrumbs.test.ts (shouldShowBreadcrumbs), tests/detail-page-header-source.test.ts, tests/schedule-timeline-source.test.ts (breadcrumb frame no longer sticky z-35). Earlier batch: 10 files / 87 tests pass.
